title: graph_version.registered
description: A new graph version entered the database (D15). entity.id is the hash of the snapshot. A cartografo extension, with no flowpilot equivalent, since there the flow is code. Registering does NOT move the graph's pointer — what moves it is graph_version.applied.

graph_id.description: The lineage the version belongs to.

parent_version.description: The hash of the previous version; null on the first version of a lineage.

source.description: Who produced the snapshot. In the PoC only manual happens: the synthesizer and the topografo are outside it (D6, D16); the other two values exist already because the source is a fact about the datum, not about the phase.

proposal_id.description: The proposal that generated the version, when source is proposal.
